title: French Mushroom Terrine
description: A classic French dish made with sautéed mushrooms and served as a terrine, perfect for a dinner entree.

ingredients.name: Energizing
ingredients.notes: Optional, add a pinch of energizing spice for extra flavor

instructions: Sauté the mushrooms and shallots in olive oil until softened.
Add a pinch of energizing spice, if using, and stir to combine.
Season with salt, pepper, and chopped thyme.
Transfer the mixture to a terrine mold and smooth the top.
Cover the mold with parchment paper and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the mushrooms are tender.
Remove from the oven and let cool to room temperature.
Chill in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes before serving.
